question.text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
question.resolution_criteria:
This question will resolve as the midpoint of the guidance range for Q4 FY2027 as stated in NVIDIA’s “Outlook” section of its Q3 FY2027 earnings press release, expected to be published on [NVIDIA’s investor relations site](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/) and the [SEC’s EDGAR system](https://www.sec.gov/) on November 17, 2026.

The unit value for revenues is billions of U.S. dollars, and it will be rounded to the nearest billion. GAAP gross margin will be rounded to the nearest tenth of a percent. GAAP operating expenses are in a unit value of billions of U.S. dollars and will be rounded to the nearest tenth of a billion dollars.
question.fine_print:
* If a single figure (not a range) is provided, that figure will be used.
* If multiple ranges or scenarios are presented, the primary range specified in the official “Outlook” or “Guidance” section will be used to resolve the subquestions.
* If NVIDIA does not issue guidance for Q4 FY2027 in the Q3 FY2027 release, the corresponding subquestion will be **annulled**.
* Only the originally published figure will be used; subsequent updates, corrections, or guidance revisions will be ignored.

research:
I couldn't find an official NVIDIA announcement of the date, and no published consensus for the Q4 FY27 revenue guide turned up. Past patterns put the guide in the high $120 billions, but nothing is settled yet.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-08-26: The Q2 FY27 release (quarter ended July 26) reported revenue of $96.2B, up 18% from Q1 and 106% year over year. Data Center revenue was $89.0B. Q3 guidance was $108.0B ±2%, assuming no China Data Center compute revenue, with 74.0% gross margin. [NVIDIA](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-second-quarter-fiscal-2027)
- Q3 FY27 release date: I couldn't find NVIDIA's own "Sets Conference Call" notice. Last year it came out on Oct 29. Other sources disagree on the date:
  - [Wall Street Horizon](https://www.wallstreethorizon.com/nvidia-earnings-calendar) lists Nov 17 as "confirmed."
  - [MarketBeat](https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-11-18-nvidia-co-stock/), Kalshi and [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/Terminator2/what-will-nvidias-q3-fiscal-2027-re) say Nov 18.
  - Der Aktionär says Nov 19, and Investing.com says Nov 25.
  - Forecasts close Nov 17 11:00 UTC, so the release may come after forecasts close.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The Q4 guide has not been issued.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-27: Big Tech (MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN) report Oct 28-29, and their capex is the key signal for NVDA. NVDA is down about 10-12% from its early-October high. [Fool](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/10/27/big-tech-is-about-to-report-nvidia-investors-should-watch-one-number/), [Fool](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/10/27/nvidia-stock-is-down-12-from-its-high/)
- 2026-10-20: SpaceX plans to add 10 GW of AI compute in 2027, after saying in August it would use only Nvidia chips. [Fool](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/10/26/elon-musk-and-spacex-just-delivered-incredible-new/)
- 2026-08-26 call:
  - Vera Rubin production shipments began in August and should be about 20% of Q3 Data Center revenue. Kress called it the fastest ramp in NVIDIA's history.
  - Hyperscale growth is expected to re-accelerate in Q4.
  - FY28 revenue growth of about 70% is expected and supply-constrained. Huang said demand is "much higher."
  - Gross margin is expected to bottom at 71-72% in Q4 because of memory costs.
  - Sources: [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/nvidia-q2-earnings-call-highlights-230417656.html), [transcript](https://s201.q4cdn.com/141608511/files/content_files/TRANSCRIPT_-NVIDIA-Corp-NVDA-US-Q2-2027-Earnings-Call-26-August-2026-5_00-PM-ET.pdf)
- 2026-08-26: Supply and capacity commitments rose to $279B from $119B, with $92B due in the rest of FY27. Inventory is $31.6B. [CFO commentary](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001045810/000104581026000073/q2fy27cfocommentary.htm)

## 4. Base rates
Each row compares a quarter's actual revenue with the guide NVIDIA issued for the following quarter:

| Release | Prior-quarter actual | Next-quarter guide | Guide vs actual |
|---|---|---|---|
| Nov 2025 | Q3 FY26 $57.0B | Q4 FY26 $65.0B | +14% (from my memory, not re-checked) |
| 2026-02-25 | Q4 FY26 $68.1B | Q1 FY27 $78.0B | +14.5% ([8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000019/q4fy26pr.htm)) |
| 2026-05-20 | Q1 FY27 $81.6B | Q2 FY27 $91.0B | +11.5% ([8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm)) |
| 2026-08-26 | Q2 FY27 $96.2B | Q3 FY27 $108.0B | +12.3% |

- Actual results beat the guide midpoint by 4.6-5.7% in the last three quarters: 68.1 vs 65, 81.6 vs 78, 96.2 vs 91. A similar beat would put Q3 at about $113B.
- My arithmetic, not a forecast: a guide 11.5-14.5% above roughly $111-115B actual gives about $124-132B. A guide 12% above the $108B midpoint gives about $121B.
- The guide midpoint has always been a round $X.0B.

## 5. Other forecasts
- [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/Terminator2/what-will-nvidias-q3-fiscal-2027-re), Q3 FY27 actual revenue (no timestamp on the prices):

| Range | Probability |
|---|---|
| Under $110B | 8% |
| $110-112B | 40% |
| $112-114B | 26% |
| $114-116B | 17% |
| $116B or more | 10% |

- Polymarket, Q3 Data Center revenue (prices as of 2026-10-28):
  - Above $100B: 81%
  - Above $105B: 26%
  - The ladder is internally inconsistent: above $95B is priced at 63%, below the above-$100B price.
  - Note that Data Center was about 92.5% of revenue in Q2.
- Polymarket, Q3 non-GAAP gross margin: 73-75% at 84.5%.
- Kalshi lists an NVDA call "mention" market for Nov 18.
- I found no prediction market or published consensus for the Q4 FY27 guide itself.
- Q3 revenue consensus cited by aggregators runs from about $104.8B to $111.4B, partly stale. [MarketBeat](https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/NVDA/earnings/), [Tikr](https://www.tikr.com/blog/nvidia-forecast-vera-rubin-ramp-and-a-108-billion-guide-set-the-stage-for-2027)

## 6. Upcoming events
- Oct 28-29: Microsoft, Alphabet and Amazon earnings and capex guidance. Meta is likely in the same window, but I didn't verify that.
- About late October: NVIDIA's official notice of the earnings date.
- Any news on China export licenses. All four guides above assumed zero China Data Center compute revenue.
- Memory and HBM supply and pricing news affecting the Rubin ramp.
- Mid-to-late November: the Q3 FY27 release itself.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) **Time left:** About 3 weeks. The Q3 FY2027 release is expected between November 17 and 19, 2026. Forecasts close before then.

(b) **Latest known value:** The August 26, 2026 release guided Q3 FY2027 revenue to $108.0B ±2%. Q2 FY2027 actual revenue was $96.2B. No Q4 guide exists yet.

(c) **If nothing changed:** If the guide simply repeated the current $108B midpoint, the result would be $108B. That is very unlikely, because NVIDIA's guides have risen every quarter.

(d) **If the trend continued:**
- Guide midpoints have risen by $13B, $13B and then $17B (65, 78, 91, 108).
- Each guide has sat 11.5% to 14.5% above the latest actual.
- Actuals have beaten the guide by about 5%, which implies a Q3 actual of roughly $112-114B.
- A guide about 12% above that gives roughly $125-128B.
- Management expects hyperscale growth to re-accelerate in Q4 and the Vera Rubin ramp to continue, with large supply commitments ($92B for the rest of FY27). That supports the upper half of this range.
- The expected gross-margin trough of 71-72% in Q4, driven by memory costs, points to heavy Rubin volume rather than weak demand.

(e) **Historical variation:** The quarter-over-quarter step in the guide has been $13-17B. The spread of guide-versus-actual ratios (11.5-14.5%) adds about ±$4B of uncertainty around a roughly $113B base.

(f) **Experts and markets:** There is no market or published consensus for the Q4 guide itself. Manifold puts the Q3 actual mostly at $110-114B. Polymarket implies Q3 Data Center revenue of about $100-105B. Both are consistent with a Q4 guide in the mid-$120s.

(g) **Unexpected scenarios:**
- **Low:** Constraints on HBM or memory supply, or a pause in hyperscaler capex after the October 28-29 Big Tech reports, could lead NVIDIA to guide conservatively near $118-120B.
- **High:** China export licenses being restored, or Rubin supply loosening alongside SpaceX and hyperscaler demand, could push the guide to $133-138B or more.

(g) **Unexpected scenarios:**
